description: Run multiple projects simultaneously with full isolation — separate sessions, budgets, org charts, and agents per project. Paperclip calls this 'multi-company'. XRoads does it better: each project is a workspace with its own git context, PRD state, and cost tracking, but with a unified dashboard to monitor everything.
goals: Multiple simultaneous projects with full isolation
Unified dashboard to monitor all workspaces
Per-workspace budgets, org charts, and agent pools
Cross-workspace agent migration (move an agent from project A to project B)
Workspace templates for quick project bootstrapping
non_goals: No workspace nesting (flat list of workspaces)

Workspace.description: A project workspace — isolates all orchestration state

fields.name: String — display name (e.g. 'XRoads Tauri', 'My API')
fields.color: String — hex color for UI badge (#0DF170, #00D4FF, etc.)
fields.isActive: Bool default false — currently focused workspace
fields.metadata: String? — JSON blob for extra config

user_stories.title: Workspace entity + DB migration
user_stories.description: Migration v12: workspace table. Each workspace maps 1:1 to a project directory. CockpitSession gains 'workspaceId' FK (nullable for backward compat, required for new sessions). CRUD repo: create, list, switch_active, update, delete. On workspace delete: close all sessions, cleanup worktrees, remove .crossroads/ data. Unique constraint on projectPath.

user_stories.title: Workspace switcher + multi-dashboard
user_stories.description: UI: 1) Workspace sidebar — vertical list of workspace badges (color + icon + name + status indicator). Click to switch. Plus button to add workspace (directory picker). Right-click for rename/delete/settings. 2) Multi-dashboard mode — split dashboard showing miniature NeonBrain per workspace with slot count and status. Click to focus. 3) Keyboard shortcut: Cmd+1-9 to switch workspace. 4) Active workspace indicator in toolbar. 5) All panels (chat, cockpit, inspector) scope to active workspace automatically.

user_stories.title: Workspace isolation guarantees
user_stories.description: Hard isolation between workspaces: 1) Separate session state — each workspace has its own active session. 2) Separate agent pool — slots only see their workspace's worktrees. 3) Separate budget tracking — costs isolated per workspace. 4) Separate org chart — role hierarchies independent. 5) Separate event streams — PTY output, status events, logs filtered by workspace. 6) Separate MCP sessions — each workspace has its own .crossroads/sessions.json. No cross-contamination between workspaces. All queries scoped by workspaceId.
tests: session A cannot see workspace B's slots
PTY output filtered by active workspace
org roles scoped to workspace session

user_stories.title: Cross-workspace agent migration
user_stories.description: Move an agent from one workspace to another (e.g. a backend agent finished project A, reassign to project B). Migration flow: 1) Pause agent in source workspace. 2) Generate handoff context (progress, learnings, skill state). 3) Create new slot in target workspace with same agent type + skill. 4) Inject handoff context into new AGENT.md. 5) Start agent in target workspace. 6) Close slot in source workspace. All via a single 'migrate_agent' Tauri command. UI: drag agent from workspace sidebar to another workspace.
tests: target slot starts with correct skill

user_stories.title: Workspace templates
user_stories.description: Pre-configured workspace templates for common project types. Templates: 1) Rust CLI (backend + testing roles, cargo-aware skills). 2) React App (frontend + backend + testing, npm-aware). 3) Full Stack (all roles, git-flow branching strategy). 4) Data Pipeline (ETL + testing + review roles). Each template pre-configures: max slots, default org chart template, budget preset, recommended skills, .crossroads/config.json. Workspace template selector on creation. Custom templates saved per-user in ~/.xroads/workspace-templates/.
tests: React App template creates correct config

user_stories.title: Unified monitoring dashboard
user_stories.description: Global overview across all workspaces: 1) Total agents running across all workspaces. 2) Total cost across all workspaces (with per-workspace breakdown). 3) Global health status — any workspace in error state surfaces immediately. 4) Global budget consumption bar. 5) Activity feed — last 20 events across all workspaces (color-coded by workspace). 6) Quick-action menu: pause all, stop all, snapshot all. Accessible via Cmd+0 or workspace sidebar 'All' tab.
tests: total agents count correct across workspaces
global cost sums all workspace costs
error workspace surfaces in global status
pause all stops all workspace agents
